Item 5.07. Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders

On May 12, 2026, Packaging Corporation of America ("PCA") held its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, at which the following proposals were voted upon and approved by PCA's stockholders:

(a) Election of Directors. Voting results are summarized as follows:

(b) Ratification of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm. The audit committee’s appointment of KPMG LLP as PCA's independent registered public accounting firm was ratified by the following vote: 82,796,126 votes for, 744,560 votes against, and 20,724 abstentions.

(c) Approval of PCA's Executive Compensation: 76,265,206 votes for, 2,299,022 votes against, 1,021,675 abstentions and 3,975,507 broker non-votes.
